title: A repository Durable Object with one slot and one serialized publisher
description:
SPEC 12 Phase 4 item 3. Introduce the repository Durable Object: one slot, one serialized publisher, preserving the current RunRoom lease behaviour behind it.

This is the cloud host's answer to the problem this project keeps meeting on the local host: two parties writing one name. Phase 3 found it three times (FETCH_HEAD, refs/remotes, the shared peek ref) and each fix was a narrower private namespace. A Durable Object is the other answer - not disjoint namespaces but a single serialized writer - and it is worth stating which of the two each future write relies on.

Preserve RunRoom's lease semantics rather than reinventing them: the lease is what stops two runs of one epic, and it already works.
